title: Real-time identification of the onset of financial rogue waves
abstract: arXiv:2606.31475v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Extreme events in financial systems, often captured by indicators such as volatility, remain difficult to identify close to their onset. Volatility shares many statistical properties with other natural, complex systems which experience extreme events, which we explore in this manuscript. We extend the analogy between rogue waves in optical and hydrodynamical systems to financial volatility by identifying rogue-wave-like peaks with similar statistical properties. We use a Schr\"odinger equation where the potential follows the shape of a Kerr nonlinearity to examine the properties of financial volatility indices within a moving time window. We see evidence of Anderson localisation as a rogue peak approaches in the VIX, and show that the numerical gradient of the system's minimum eigenvalue reliably spikes at the onset of an extreme event. translated_title: 金融异常波发生的实时识别
translated_abstract: 金融系统中的极端事件（通常通过波动率等指标来刻画）在其临近发生时仍然难以识别。波动率与其他经历极端事件的自然复杂系统共享许多统计特性，这正是本文所探讨的内容。我们通过识别具有相似统计特性的类怪波峰值，将光学与流体动力系统中怪波之间的类比拓展到了金融波动率领域。我们使用一个势函数遵循克尔非线性形状的薛定谔方程，在滑动时间窗口内考察金融波动率指数的性质。我们观察到，在VIX指数中当怪波峰值临近时会出现安德森局域化的证据，并证明系统最小特征值的数值梯度会在极端事件发生的起点可靠地出现激增。我们将该方法调整为模拟数据的实时到达，并表明除一个例外之外，（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将光学与流体中的“怪波”类比引入金融波动率分析，利用带克尔非线性势的薛定谔方程研究VIX等波动率指数，发现极端事件临近时出现安德森局域化迹象，且系统最小特征值的数值梯度在极端事件开始时可靠激增，从而实现对金融极端事件起点的实时识别。
en_tdlr: The paper extends the rogue-wave analogy to financial volatility by analyzing volatility indices with a Schrödinger equation whose potential follows a Kerr nonlinearity, showing evidence of Anderson localization in the VIX as a rogue peak approaches and that the numerical gradient of the system's minimum eigenvalue reliably spikes at the onset of an extreme event, enabling real-time identification of financial extreme events.
